blocks.text: When you have a 4-piece comfortable outdoor furniture set, protecting them from the elements is crucial. Baner Garden's outdoor furniture covers provide waterproof protection for your patio furniture set, including a three seats sofa cover,2 chair covers and a coffee table cover. These covers are designed to fit a 4-piece patio conversation set, keeping your furniture safe and dry from rain, snow, and other harsh weather conditions. With Baner Garden's patio furniture covers, you can extend the lifespan of your outdoor furniture and enjoy it for years to come.

items.label: 4 Pieces Patio Furniture Sets Cover
items.value: Ensure the longevity of your 4-piece patio conversation set with our all-weather furniture cover set. This set includes 1 sofa cover, 2 chair covers, and 1 coffee table cover, providing comprehensive protection for your deck, porch, patio, lawn, garden, poolside, and other indoor and outdoor areas featuring outdoor leisure rattan wicker furniture.

items.label: Cover Measurement
items.value: To guarantee a perfect fit, measure your patio furniture before making a purchase. Our sofa cover accommodates dimensions up to 77.5"W x 32.5"D x 32"H, armchair covers fit up to 32.5"W x 32.5"D x 32"H, and the coffee table cover fits up to 47.5"W x 25"D x 16"H. Coverage depends on the size of your furniture set, particularly the depth of the chairs. Please measure your furniture carefully before placing an order.

items.label: Waterproof and UV Resistant
items.value: Crafted from 600D Oxford Polyester fabric, our patio furniture cover boasts a silver-coated PU waterproof undercoating that effectively repels rain and snow. The silver UV-resistant coating safeguards your furniture from sun damage in both summer and winter. Additionally, it shields against dust, leaves, and bird droppings, ensuring your furniture stays clean and dry.

items.label: Secure Fit & Easy Storage
items.value: Featuring click-close windproof buckle straps and adjustable drawstrings, our covers provide a secure fit, even in windy conditions. For added convenience, each cover comes with a storage bag, making it easy to store when not in use. The buckle straps and drawstrings at the bottom ensure a snug fit, preventing the covers from slipping off.

items.label: Easy to Maintain and Warranty
items.value: Our outdoor furniture covers are designed for ease of use and maintenance. Lightweight and easily installed and removed, they can be cleaned by simply rinsing with water or wiping with a damp cloth. For longevity, avoid machine washing or dry cleaning. Backed by a 1-year warranty, we recommend creating a slope for water and debris to flow off easily by placing objects under the cover.
